Doctoral studies
Doctoral studies
Chalmers offers an attractive and competitive doctoral education in a strong research environment in an international atmosphere.
About doctoral studies
Graduate schools
Chalmers' post­grad­u­ate education is organised in the form of subject-oriented graduate schools, which are responsible for course offerings, seminar activities, study follow-up and more. All doctoral students must belong to a graduate school at Chalmers, but may also be affiliated with national and inter­na­tional research schools.
Read more
Graduate courses
Here you can find Chalmers' PhD courses. Sort by department or research school. Graduate courses given by the Department of Math­e­mat­i­cal Sciences can be found in the University of Gothenburg course database (see link in navigation).For some courses, no start date is specified. Many of these courses are nev­er­the­less given regularly. For more information about these courses, please contact the course coordinator.
Read more
Joint graduate courses
Thanks to col­lab­o­ra­tions between uni­ver­si­ties in the Nordic countries, graduate students at Chalmers can apply to PhD courses at five other uni­ver­si­ties.
Read more
About doctoral studies
PhD positions
As a doctoral student, you are employed by Chalmers. All doctoral positions are advertised under Vacant positions.
